gui_forms::TextBox.summary: TextBox is a retained single-line Unicode editor with scalar-safe navigation, directional selection, clipboard/history commands, password projection, bounded user-input length, caret animation, semantic editing, and ordered text/selection events.
remarks: Single-line editing uses scalar-safe navigation, directional selection, clipboard and history commands, password projection, a bounded user-input length, and caret animation.
Multiline mode with `set_auto_scroll(true)` exposes the inherited `ScrollableControl` document scrollbars; explicit scrolling preserves text, selection, and undo history.
Word wrapping suppresses horizontal overflow and measures against the space beside the vertical bar. Cached rows survive scrolling and unchanged paints.
gui_forms::TextBox.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::TextBox.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::TextBox.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
